name: Nike A Ma Maniere X Pegasus Premium SP 'Summit White Metallic Silver'
story_html: The A Ma Maniére x Pegasus Premium SP 'Summit White Metallic Silver' updates the performance road running shoe in an essential two-tone palette. The white mesh and textile upper features a molded metallic silver Swoosh with contrasting black accents on the curvilinear overlay and textile collar lining. 'A Ma Maniére' is inscribed in muted violet script on the lateral forefoot of the right shoe. The sneaker rides atop a cream-colored ZoomX foam midsole, augmented with full-length Zoom Air cushioning and ReactX foam in the heel.
